categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Xili Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of electric energy metering products including smart electric meters (single-phase and three-phase), electricity information collection terminals, and electric energy metering boxes. The company also explores new energy products such as outdoor mobile power supplies and energy storage systems through its subsidiary Zhejiang Xili New Energy Co., Ltd. It serves mainly the electric power industry with a focus on energy metering and related IoT applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary core technologies including high-reliability data storage middleware, modular software design, comprehensive energy management design, smart meter reliability design, adaptive power management, high-precision metering, and automated production and quality control technologies. It has developed an MES manufacturing execution system integrated with ERP for precise production management. The company holds over 100 patents and numerous software copyrights, emphasizing innovation in metering accuracy, communication protocols, and product reliability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major electric grid companies such as State Grid Corporation of China and Southern Power Grid, along with their provincial subsidiaries. The products are widely used in residential, industrial, commercial, and public sectors for electricity metering and data collection. The company also exports to Southeast Asia, South Asia, South America, and Africa, targeting emerging smart grid markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a nationwide sales and technical service network. It has expanded overseas sales to regions including Southeast Asia, South Asia, South America, and Africa. Its subsidiaries are located in Zhejiang Province, China, with headquarters in Hangzhou and production facilities in Deqing.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xili Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the electric energy metering supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of smart meters and related data collection devices. It also extends upstream by producing some components like transformers and meter shells internally to ensure supply stability and cost control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous technological innovation and R&D investment, dedicating over 6% of revenue to research. Strategic R&D focuses include upgrading smart meter standards, developing new generation meters compliant with national grid requirements, IoT-enabled metering solutions, and new energy storage products. It actively participates in national standards formulation and pursues advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) technologies aligned with smart grid and carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of smart electric meters, electricity information collection terminals, and metering boxes to electric grid companies via bidding and contracts. The company also earns income from exports and provides after-sales services. Investment income from equity and financial assets contributes additionally but is not the main revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Xili Technology is a nationally recognized high-tech enterprise with a strong market position in China's smart electric meter industry. It holds a comprehensive product portfolio and advanced technologies, consistently rated as a top-tier supplier (Class A) by State Grid. The company competes with other domestic smart meter manufacturers but differentiates itself through innovation, quality, and integrated production capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 565 million, a 4.21% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 74.46 million, up 17%. Total assets stood at about RMB 1 billion with steady growth in net assets. The company maintains positive cash flow from operations and invests significantly in R&D, reflecting a stable growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xili Technology emphasizes high-precision, low-power consumption, multifunctional smart metering products with robust reliability and advanced communication capabilities. Its integrated software and hardware solutions, modular design, and automated manufacturing processes enable rapid customization and high-quality output. The company’s commitment to innovation, quality certifications, and comprehensive after-sales support provide competitive differentiation in the smart energy metering market.
